name: ds-ide-to-web
description: A local bridge that lets any AI tool talk to your logged-in DeepSeek web chat: OpenAI-compatible API plus MCP, through a browser extension.

scripts.sign:firefox: npm run build && npx --yes web-ext@10.8.0 sign --source-dir bridge/build/firefox --artifacts-dir bridge/build/signed --channel unlisted
scripts.test: npm run test:extension && npm run test:server
